reader_summary.overview: Sloane Payne and Dave Joerger are the COO and CCO of WCM Investment Management. This special conversation was hosted by Scott MacDonald on our affiliate Investment Management Operations podcast. Sloane and Dave believe the atypical human blend of these disciplines has been the primary driver of the firm's success.

key_points.text: Sloane Payne and Dave Joerger are the COO and CCO of WCM Investment Management.
Although not the origin of its name, it's perhaps not surprising that WCM also stands for Why Culture Matters.
